question: Which of the following is the first African country to sign the International Solar Alliance (ISA) in April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mauritius**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Mauritius became the first African country to sign the International Solar Alliance (ISA) in April 2025, demonstrating its commitment to renewable energy and sustainable development.
 
• The International Solar Alliance (ISA) is an initiative launched by India and France during the COP21 climate conference in 2015 with the goal of promoting solar energy deployment globally.
 
• Mauritius has been actively working towards renewable energy solutions, with solar energy forming a significant part of its energy strategy.
 
• The signing of the ISA agreement by Mauritius signifies its alignment with global efforts to combat climate change and transition towards clean energy.
 
• As a member of the ISA, Mauritius will benefit from technical cooperation, capacity building, and financial assistance to expand its solar energy projects.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Senegal:**

 
 
• Senegal is a West African nation that has been investing in renewable energy, particularly solar and wind power, to reduce its dependence on fossil fuels.
 
• Although Senegal has joined the ISA, it was not the first African country to sign the agreement.
 
• The country’s solar projects, such as the Bokhol Solar Park, are part of its efforts to achieve sustainable energy goals.
 
 
 
• **Lesotho:**
 
 
• Lesotho, a landlocked country in Southern Africa, heavily relies on hydroelectric power for its energy needs.
 
• It has shown interest in diversifying its energy mix but is not yet a major player in solar energy initiatives like the ISA.
 
• Lesotho’s renewable energy focus includes small-scale solar projects aimed at rural electrification.
 
 
 
• **Egypt:**
 
 
• Egypt is one of the leading countries in Africa in renewable energy development, with significant investments in solar and wind power.
 
• The Benban Solar Park in Egypt is one of the largest solar installations in the world.
